purpose: Declare the smallest authority-bearing HF01 assurance surface after claim-relative validator correction.
v2_corrections: terminal authority is computed only from roles required by the endpoint claim type
extra non-required role records remain auditable but cannot false-block weaker claims
duplicate required roles are rejected as ambiguous
projection_assurance delegates authority validation to projection_validator_v2
legacy_boundary: projection_protocol.py remains the shared enum/dataclass/schema source for compatibility; its v1 validate_projection_certificate function is not the normative authority validator in kernel v2.
kernel_rules: Only normative-authority-kernel components may directly determine empirical claim acceptance.
Diagnostic/advisory components may warn, optimize or attack but must not silently upgrade authority.
A change to a schema dependency or normative authority component invalidates certificates bound to the previous kernel revision.
Adding authority-bearing code requires a documented failure class not blocked by the current kernel.
